Description

The Kai Corporation Tweezers KQ3215 Slanted Tip with Cap for Eyebrows offers precise control for grooming and shaping your eyebrows with ease. Designed with a slanted tip, these tweezers allow you to target and remove unwanted hairs accurately, making eyebrow maintenance straightforward and efficient.

Crafted for comfort and durability, these tweezers come with a protective cap to keep the tips clean and sharp between uses. Perfect for daily grooming routines, the Kai Corporation Tweezers help you achieve well-defined brows effortlessly, enhancing your overall look.

Details

  • Format: Tool
  • Manufacturer: Kai Corporation

Features

  • Slanted tip design for precise and easy hair removal
  • Protective cap included to maintain cleanliness and sharpness
  • Durable construction for long-lasting use
  • Ideal for accurate eyebrow grooming and shaping

How to use

Hold the tweezers firmly and use the slanted tip to grasp unwanted eyebrow hairs at the root. Pull hairs out gently in the direction of growth to minimize discomfort. Use the protective cap to cover the tips after each use to keep them clean. Use daily or as needed to maintain well-shaped eyebrows.
